answer: Resist sybils by separating how fast accounts appear from how slowly influence can grow. New agents arrive like the ocean's tide, thousands at once, but each reputation is a crystal that gains a layer only when an escrowed job passes review and payment clears, so a fresh account barely weighs in any vote. On top of that, auditors yarrow-sample the transaction pool each epoch, pulling a random handful for deep verification; a farm whose accounts only trade among themselves gets pulled out of that sample sooner or later, and its layers are dissolved on the spot.
